records.title: Dispatch Loom
records.subtitle: Dispatch reconciliation tool · Harbor Tools
records.summary: Personally designed and built an operational dispatch reconciliation tool for matching overnight spreadsheets against daily exports and surfacing understandable exceptions. Personally wrote the Python parser and SQL checks; used Git for version control and PostgreSQL for production data. The tool supported dispatch operators’ reconciliation work; the six-run time reduction was a team result.
